scope: curated public edition; not a mirror or full upstream export
review: Both full source files were read. They contain reusable policy, generic source references and no personal account records. Public core, PBS and handoff are new sanitized adaptations. Original runtime, BOOT, preferences, state, packs, archives and private history are not exported.

trading history, datasets and live state
private handoffs, archives and Git history
limits: Manual content review plus deterministic checks is not a proof that every possible sensitive datum has been detected. Export extensions require fresh review. Generic references to non-exported files confer no access.
setup_review: New setup poll, explicit contribution preview/consent, private progress-review distinction, portable exit/return commands, and exact 4.2069 percent return policy. All are generic policy with no participant information; checkout is unconfigured.
